svg.metadata: {"story":"Moses","act":15,"chapter":"Ch.15 · Mount Nebo","scene":"A","layer":"background","artDirection":"Moses goes up to Mount Nebo and sees the whole land, and the Lord buries him in the valley; a prophet without equal in Israel.
